entities.name: Query ATP synthase delta
observations: 182 aa bacterial protein; exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt A9KK95.
Predicted molecular weight 20.67 kDa and theoretical pI 6.77.
Pfam OSCP domain PF00213.24 spans residues 5-176 with i-Evalue 8e-50.
No catalytic reaction was assigned; sequence and homolog evidence support a structural ATP synthase stalk role.

entities.name: ATP synthase subunit delta
observations: Reviewed bacterial F1F0 ATP synthase peripheral-stalk component.
Forms part of the peripheral stalk with subunit b, linking F1 catalytic domain to F0 membrane sector.
Supports mechanical coupling during proton- or sodium-gradient-driven ATP synthesis; it is not itself the catalytic ATP-forming subunit.
Annotated as a peripheral membrane-associated protein in curated homologs.

entities.name: ATP synthase OSCP domain
observations: Pfam OSCP family PF00213.24 detected across nearly the full query sequence, residues 5-176.
The OSCP-like domain is consistent with the bacterial ATP synthase delta/peripheral-stalk head architecture.

entities.name: ATP synthase subunit b
observations: The bacterial peripheral stalk commonly pairs subunit b with subunit delta to anchor the F1 head to the F0 membrane sector.
